package domain

import (
	"sort"
	"strings"
)

const (
	StudentPlanningProfileVersion = "student-onboarding-v1"
	StudentMasteryPolicyVersion   = "student-mastery-v1"
)

type StudentPlanningProfile struct {
	DirectionCode          string   `json:"direction_code"`
	SelfAssessedExperience string   `json:"self_assessed_experience"`
	KnownStacks            []string `json:"known_stacks"`
	DesiredStacks          []string `json:"desired_stacks"`
	GoalCode               string   `json:"goal_code"`
	PreferredLanguage      string   `json:"preferred_language"`
	WeeklyMinutes          int      `json:"weekly_minutes"`
	PreferredPace          string   `json:"preferred_pace"`
	ProfileVersion         string   `json:"profile_version"`
	OnboardingVersion      int64    `json:"onboarding_version"`
	LearningPathVersion    int64    `json:"-"`
	LearningPathCourseID   string   `json:"-"`
	LearningPathGoalCode   string   `json:"-"`
	LearningPathRevision   string   `json:"-"`
}

func NormalizeStudentPlanningProfile(input StudentPlanningProfile) (StudentPlanningProfile, error) {
	input.DirectionCode = normalizeCode(input.DirectionCode)
	input.SelfAssessedExperience = normalizeCode(input.SelfAssessedExperience)
	input.GoalCode = normalizeCode(input.GoalCode)
	input.PreferredLanguage = normalizeCode(input.PreferredLanguage)
	input.PreferredPace = normalizeCode(input.PreferredPace)
	input.ProfileVersion = strings.TrimSpace(input.ProfileVersion)
	input.KnownStacks = normalizeCodes(input.KnownStacks)
	input.DesiredStacks = normalizeCodes(input.DesiredStacks)
	if input.DirectionCode == "" || input.SelfAssessedExperience == "" || input.GoalCode == "" ||
		input.PreferredLanguage == "" || input.PreferredPace == "" ||
		input.ProfileVersion != StudentPlanningProfileVersion || input.WeeklyMinutes < 15 ||
		input.WeeklyMinutes > 10080 || len(input.DesiredStacks) == 0 {
		return StudentPlanningProfile{}, ErrValidation
	}
	return input, nil
}

type MasteryState string

const (
	MasteryUnknown    MasteryState = "UNKNOWN"
	MasteryExposed    MasteryState = "EXPOSED"
	MasteryUnderstood MasteryState = "UNDERSTOOD"
	MasteryPracticed  MasteryState = "PRACTICED"
	MasteryApplied    MasteryState = "APPLIED"
	MasteryMastered   MasteryState = "MASTERED"
)

type TargetMastery struct {
	Target        TargetRef    `json:"target"`
	State         MasteryState `json:"state"`
	MasteryScore  float64      `json:"mastery_score"`
	Confidence    float64      `json:"confidence"`
	PolicyVersion string       `json:"policy_version"`
}

func NormalizeTargetMastery(input TargetMastery) (TargetMastery, error) {
	target, err := NormalizeTargetRef(input.Target)
	if err != nil || !validMasteryState(input.State) || input.MasteryScore < 0 || input.MasteryScore > 1 ||
		input.Confidence < 0 || input.Confidence > 1 ||
		strings.TrimSpace(input.PolicyVersion) != StudentMasteryPolicyVersion {
		return TargetMastery{}, ErrValidation
	}
	input.Target = target
	input.PolicyVersion = strings.TrimSpace(input.PolicyVersion)
	return input, nil
}

func validMasteryState(input MasteryState) bool {
	switch input {
	case MasteryUnknown, MasteryExposed, MasteryUnderstood, MasteryPracticed, MasteryApplied, MasteryMastered:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func normalizeCodes(inputs []string) []string {
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(inputs))
	result := make([]string, 0, len(inputs))
	for _, input := range inputs {
		normalized := normalizeCode(input)
		if normalized == "" {
			continue
		}
		if _, duplicate := seen[normalized]; duplicate {
			continue
		}
		seen[normalized] = struct{}{}
		result = append(result, normalized)
	}
	sort.Strings(result)
	return result
}

func normalizeCode(input string) string { return strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input)) }
